How it decides

A team of specialists on every answer.

No rules written in advance: every request is read by a model, and Celestin decides for itself.

It splits the work into its smallest pieces

Not "research" but "the five moments a 9-year-old finds most gripping, with dates". Each piece is one precise skill, and later pieces build on earlier ones.

Each piece goes to the model best at exactly that

Weighed on 101 measured skills from millions of real votes, re-ranked every day, plus Celestin's own record of which model's work holds up at what.

It's put together, checked and fixed

The best writer for the answer combines the pieces, the model best at that field checks every fact, and what it finds is fixed before you see it.

FAQ

Questions

Why not just use one model?

No single model is best at everything. Labs leapfrog each other every few weeks, and the best coder is rarely the best researcher or the best writer. Celestin keeps track so you don't have to.

How does it decide?

A fast model reads every request and decides what would serve you (an answer, an app, a video, research...) and how to do it. Then each part goes to the models that score highest on exactly that work: on LMArena's leaderboards (which answer people prefer) and on Epoch AI's benchmarks (whether the code passes its tests, the maths is right, the facts are true), at the price that buys that quality and no more. You can also choose Fast, Max, or one model yourself.

Can it use my computer?

Only if you run its small connector on your computer, and it asks before it changes anything. Without it, Celestin still runs code, searches and builds right in your browser.

What does it cost?

Everyone with an account gets free credits that come back every 5 hours. For more, a plan (Nova, Pulsar or Quasar) gives you far more for a month (no auto-renewal), and a credit pack tops you up instantly.

Is my data safe?

Your chats, projects and memory stay in this browser. What you ask goes through Celestin's server to the model answering it, and isn't kept there.

Which model answered me?

The best one for each part, picked for you. "Show models used" on any answer shows who did what, and why.

Ask your first question.
